newsitem.title: INDIA: India VSNL, ICO Global in pact for satellite node.
newsitem.headline: India VSNL, ICO Global in pact for satellite node.

text.p: India's state-run Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) and ICO Global Communications signed an agreement on Tuesday to set up a $50 million satellite access node for mobile communications, ICO said in a statement.
ICO Global, a private company set up last year to provide personal mobile communications worldwide, said its global node will serve not only India but a number of other countries in the region.

"Under the agreement, ICO will establish one of its 12 global satellite access nodes (SAN) in India. VSNL is one of the 12 companies which won the bid for the SAN complex following competition and 27 bidders from around the world to locate the global nodes in their countries," the statement said.
"ICO will invest $50 million in the SAN facility at VSNL's existing facility at Chattarpur, near Delhi," it said.
